cues.zh: 這堂課要對資料做些前處理。

cues.zh: 我們已處理缺失值，也把類別值轉成連續值或虛擬變數。

cues.en: Now it's time to perform a train_test_split and normalize the data.
cues.zh: 現在要進行 train_test_split，並將資料正規化。

cues.en: Afterwards, we can then create the model.
cues.zh: 之後就能建立模型。

cues.en: Let's get started.

cues.en: Okay, here we are back at the notebook.

cues.zh: 使用 from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split。

cues.en: And after we've done that, the next task is to drop the loan_status column we created earlier since it's essentially a duplicate of the loan_repaid column.
cues.zh: 完成後，下一個任務是刪除先前建立的 loan_status 欄，因為和 loan_repaid 基本上是重複資訊。

cues.en: And we'll use the loan_repaid column since it's already in 0s and 1s.
cues.zh: 我們會用 loan_repaid，因為已經是零和一。

cues.en: So we'll do the following, we'll say df is equal to df.drop and then say loan_status,
cues.zh: 所以使用 df = df.drop，傳入 loan_status，

cues.zh: axis=1。

cues.en: Okay. After that, we'll set X and Y variables to the values of the feature and the label.
cues.zh: 好，接著把 X 和 Y 設為特徵與標籤的值。

cues.en: So we can do that by simply saying X is equal to df, go ahead and drop loan_repaid, along axis is equal to one,
cues.zh: 讓 X 等於 df 沿 axis=1 刪除 loan_repaid 的結果，

cues.en: and I just want the values there.
cues.zh: 只取得 values。

cues.en: And then Y is going to be equal to df loan_repaid, and then grab those values and run that.
cues.zh: Y 則是 df 的 loan_repaid，再取得 values，執行。

cues.en: Alright, now this next step is completely optional.
cues.zh: 接下來這步完全可以自行選擇。

cues.en: It really depends on how you're running this.
cues.zh: 取決於你的執行環境。

cues.zh: 如果沒有在 Google Cloud 平台上跑，而是在本機，記憶體較少或沒有 GPU，

cues.zh: 可以選擇只抽取整份資料集的一部分，節省訓練時間。

cues.en: Now keep in mind if you only grab a sample, you probably won't perform as well because you're not seeing as many correct examples.
cues.zh: 請記得，只抽樣部分資料，表現可能比較差，因為看過的正確範例較少。

cues.en: So there are methods here for you to sample and that is you can say df.sample and you can provide a sampling that you want to take.
cues.zh: 這裡有抽樣方法，可以呼叫 df.sample，指定要抽取的比例。

cues.en: Maybe you only wanna take 10% or 20% of the data and set that as your data frame.
cues.zh: 例如只抽 10% 或 20%，作為資料框。

cues.en: Since I'm running this on a GPU, I'll go ahead and keep the entire data frame but keep in mind if you are just kind of following along but don't really need to spend all the time with the training,
cues.zh: 因為我用 GPU 執行，會保留整份資料框；但如果只是跟著操作，不需要花那麼多時間訓練，

cues.en: you could take just a sample of the data.
cues.zh: 可以只使用資料的樣本。

cues.en: Next, we'll perform a train_test_split.
cues.zh: 接著進行 train_test_split。

cues.en: So we can simply say train_test_split.
cues.zh: 直接呼叫 train_test_split。

cues.en: We'll go ahead and copy this from the doc string, so scroll down here until you see this result.

cues.zh: test_size 設為 0.2；為了取得和我相同的切分，把 random_state 設成隨意選的 101。

cues.en: We run that and now that we've done the train_test_split we can normalize our data.
cues.zh: 執行後，已完成 train_test_split，就能正規化資料。

cues.en: We'll go ahead and use the MinMaxScaler that we've been using throughout the course.
cues.zh: 使用本節一直用的 MinMaxScaler。

cues.en: We'll say from sklearn.preprocessing import MinMaxScaler.
cues.zh: 從 sklearn.preprocessing 匯入 MinMaxScaler。

cues.en: Create an instance of that MinMaxScaler and then go ahead and start transforming your data.
cues.zh: 建立 MinMaxScaler 實例，接著開始轉換資料。

cues.zh: 讓 X_train 等於 scaler 一次執行 fit_transform 的結果，

cues.zh: 傳入目前的 X_train 資料集。

cues.en: Run that.
cues.zh: 執行。

cues.en: And then for the X_test data set we don't want to fit to that.
cues.zh: X_test 則不要擬合。

cues.en: We just want to transform to prevent any data leakage from our test set.
cues.zh: 只做 transform，避免測試集資料洩漏。

cues.en: Okay, so we've normalized the data and then up next we'll go ahead and create the model.
cues.zh: 好，資料已正規化，接著就要建立模型。

cues.zh: 下一堂課會著重建立模型。

cues.en: I'll see you there.
